name: Galé and Albufeira Loop
description: The easy western spin from Albufeira: 45 km of rolling coastal lanes via Galé with under 500 m of climbing. A recovery-day staple.

name: Albufeira to Alte Loop
description: 65 km inland to the spring-fed village of Alte through the rolling Algarve backroads — quiet lanes, cork oak and a proper café stop.

name: Albufeira to Portimão Coastal Loop
description: 93 km west along the coast to Portimão and back — flat to rolling with the Atlantic never far away.

name: Monchique and Fóia Loop
description: 87 km from Lagoa up into the Serra de Monchique and the Fóia climb — the Algarve's highest road at 902 m with views to both coasts.

name: Monchique and Fóia from Lagos
description: The western big day: 106 km from Lagos through the foothills to Monchique, up Fóia and home through the quiet inland lanes.

name: Alto do Malhão Big Loop
description: The full inland epic: 134 km through the Serra do Caldeirão taking in Salir, Barranco do Velho and the famous Volta ao Algarve wall finish at Alto do Malhão.

name: Carvoeiro and Albufeira Loop
description: 65 km of rolling coastal countryside between Albufeira and Carvoeiro — the relaxed middle-distance option.

name: Malhão 80
description: The direct hit: 81 km inland with the famous Alto do Malhão wall as the centrepiece — the Volta ao Algarve finish climb without the full epic distance.
